label: Record each draft
description: Domain graph behind monitor.recordAll where the entries live behind an upstream API: the same fan-out as record-all, and nothing that says the rows move together. An HTTP call cannot take part in a transaction, so this profile gets the graph without the promise rather than a promise the upstream cannot keep. Which of the two a run uses is the binding's choice, and the caller's graph does not change.

nodes.label: Record each draft
nodes.description: monitor.submit once per row; the row's url and method are the submission
